description: This file defines the class InvalidClientStateTransitionException, which extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException. It represents an exception thrown when a client transition action violates domain rules in the system.

classes.name: InvalidClientStateTransitionException
classes.description: An exception indicating an invalid transition between client states, used to signal rule violations in client state changes.

methods.name: InvalidClientStateTransitionException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception for an invalid client state transition, with details about the action and error message.
